say:4:1310919001:0.text: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?
say:4:1310919001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看这个雪人的装饰，满满觉得好眼熟，唔，让我想想……
say:4:1310919001:0.male: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?
say:4:1310919001:0.female: Magister, look at this snowman. Does it look familiar somehow...?

say:8:1310919002:0.text: Are you hamsters? I've never seen such teeny-tiny, squishy cuties before!
say:8:1310919002:0.source_cn: 你们是仓鼠吗？我还从来没见过你们这么可爱的种族！

say:9:1310919003:0.text: Whoa, it's the princess! You're super duper pretty!
say:9:1310919003:0.source_cn: 哇，是公主小姐姐！公主小姐姐好漂亮！<key:dial...

say:10:1310919004:0.text: Oh... Princess Your Highness, you're really really pretty! Wanna build a snowman with me?
say:10:1310919004:0.source_cn: 那……公主小姐姐殿下好漂亮哦！你们要不要和我一起堆雪人...

say:11:1310919005:0.text: Yay! Let's build the biggest snowmen ever!
say:11:1310919005:0.source_cn: 太好了，咱们一起堆几个又大又好看的雪人！<key:di...

say:17:1310919008:0.text: Wow, this snowman is so lifelike. Even its expression is so similar.
say:17:1310919008:0.source_cn: 哇，这个雪人简直是惟妙惟肖，连表情都堆得这么像。

say:18:1310919009:0.text: Hey, where did the princess go? Shouldn't she be waiting here for us to build a snowman?
say:18:1310919009:0.source_cn: 咦，公主殿下跑到哪里去了？她不是应该在这里等我们堆雪人吗？

say:19:1310919010:0.text: Maybe she went somewhere else... Don't worry though. She has that big knight as her bodyguard. Nothing will happen to her.
say:19:1310919010:0.source_cn: 也许她去了其他的地方……别担心，她身边有那位又高又大的...

choice:16:0:1.text: The snowman looks like that kid...
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 雪人很像那个戴熊头帽的小孩子
choice:16:0:1.male: The snowman looks like that kid...
choice:16:0:1.female: The snowman looks like that kid...

say:21:1310919007:0.text: No, this is the child who built the snowmen with us!
say:21:1310919007:0.source_cn: 不对不对，这是那个和我们一起堆雪人的孩子！

choice:16:1:2.text: Is this the snowman we made?
choice:16:1:2.male: Is this the snowman we made?
choice:16:1:2.female: Is this the snowman we made?
